mainEntity.name: What is a vacation rental travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vacation rental travel insurance plans help cover your travel investment when traveling to a vacation rental property. This can be a smart move since cancellation policies often vary from rental to rental, and there’s often uncertainty around travel changes. Travel Guard’s travel insurance plans can help protect your travel investment, so you have the flexibility you need. Several Travel Guard plans offer Trip Exchange , which can reimburse you for certain costs associated with shifting your travel dates on your reservation.

mainEntity.name: What does a vacation rental travel insurance plan cover?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel Guard offers customizable travel insurance plans for your vacation.  Look for a plan  that has the benefit limits and coverage you need. Popular plan features include:

- Medical expense coverage

- Trip cancellation coverage

- Baggage coverage

- Trip exchange coverage – the flexibility to adjust your travel dates

- Rental home lockout coverage

- Car rental coverage

- Cancel for Any Reason (optional add-on coverage available with certain plans)

- Emergency travel assistance – specialized representatives are available day or night for unexpected travel issues

mainEntity.name: Do I need a vacation rental travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: For any vacation it’s smart to cover your travel investment, but it can be even more important with a vacation rental. Restrictive cancellations policies and lack of flexibility can leave your travel investment at risk. That’s why Travel Guard’s  Deluxe Plan  or  Preferred Plan  are smart options for vacation rental travel insurance, both offer optional add-ons that allow you to customize your plan to fit your needs. Plus, all of Travel Guard’s travel insurance plans come with access to our specially trained representatives for  24/7 emergency travel assistance .

mainEntity.name: Which Travel Guard insurance plan is best for my vacation rental trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel Guard’s  Preferred Plan  is a great option for travelers looking to book a vacation rental. As our most popular plan, the Preferred Plan offers great coverage limits and a comprehensive suite of benefits. It’s also customizable and can be tailored to your specific needs – add cancel for any reason or Travel Guard’s  rental vehicle damage coverage  to create just what you need.

mainEntity.name: How much does a vacation rental travel insurance plan cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A travel insurance plan typically costs between 5-7% of your total trip cost. There are several factors at play when pricing your insurance like the product you select and any add-ons you choose. Check out our article on  how much travel insurance costs  for even more detail.

mainEntity.name: Does a travel insurance plan cover vacation rentals?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your Travel Guard travel insurance plan can cover the pre-paid, non-refundable costs of your trip. This can include your vacation rental as well. Be sure and read the cancellation policy of your rental, and the terms and conditions of the travel insurance plan, so you understand the options as you choose the right travel insurance plan for you.

mainEntity.name: Why purchase your vacation rental travel insurance plan through Travel Guard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel Guard is one of the world’s leading travel insurance providers with a network of service centers located in Asia, Europe and the Americas, ensuring the highest quality emergency travel services and medical assistance while you’re traveling. With early purchase benefits and optional add-on coverages, you can customize the plan and coverages you need for your vacation investment.
